main_text.l: Jurabant per Jovem, & ejus matrem-familiâs Junonem.
Jurare quandoq; solebant per omnes Deos.
Milites per Martem jurabant: Amatores per Venerem seu Dionam.
Jurabant etiam per Herculem Dium Fidium: hoc est, filium Jovis.
Per se & vitam suam jurabant, sic:
Non hercle ita sum, qui sum, nisi, &c.

page.notes: Italic and small-capital passages were transcribed as printed; the woodcut ornament is not text. Catchword "Labo-" read from the lower right. Some lines are faint in the scan.
